title: Reliable post-revoke recovery and native account-data parity
changes: Open the 24-word browser recovery as a full-window secure form when launched from an authenticated account after signer revoke; preserve the split-pane layout for initial onboarding.
On Native, bootstrap a server-verified GenyCaster account session from a short-lived verified recovery grant, then silently load profile extras, status and other account-owned data.
Retry the account-session handshake after transient network failures without treating local Farcaster identity or an unverified ticket as account authorization.
Add regression coverage for full-screen recovery and two-device account ownership.
